items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: That's right, and Max Baer, he wanted to be a playboy and so one night he didn't show up for the show and he was out with the girls, so Billy Rose fired him and that's when he got Bill Bojangles Robinson to come and take his place.
